from pathlib import Path

p=b'PROXY TCP4 127.0.0.1 127.0.0.1 1 1\r\nGET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_v1_short.bin').write_bytes(p)

{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The payload includes a full HTTP terminator so the input reaches the parser pipeline."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The input is diverted into PROXY parsing before HTTP method handling."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":158,"var":"buffer","code":"end = memchr(buffer, '\\r', line_size);","note":"The parser locates the CRLF terminator and limits the parse to the attacker-controlled prefix."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":166,"var":"dst_port","code":"src_addr = strsep_char(protocol, ' '); dst_addr = strsep_char(src_addr, ' '); src_port = strsep_char(dst_addr, ' '); dst_port = strsep_char(src_port, ' ');","note":"The line is tokenized in place and the individual fields become live pointers into the original buffer."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":177,"var":"proxy->from/proxy->to","code":"if (UNLIKELY(!parse_ascii_port(src_port, &from->sin_port))) return NULL; ...","note":"The attacker-controlled ports are parsed and written into the proxy state if validation succeeds."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1184,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"After the PROXY line, the parser continues with the HTTP tail, so any corruption would show up in subsequent request handling."}
]

print('/workspace/poc_v1_short.bin')
